# tier 2, group f45, route tour, version payload 1.3, role ab
# f45: live play at 45 on the 1, 1, 2 pattern. Read `[f45]` (holds, slips, late, off the pattern, phase taken, interpolation error, L, the lead and its changes, room judged, gate waits, fallback with both windows), `[present]` held 0/1/2/3, `[head]` play with a step p50 / p95 against 22.2 ms, `[lane]` GPU, `[vgx] dynamic resolution` sizes (864x488 pixels or more: 960/888/832/784x544 only). Pass rule: the log has `[f45] 45 cadence on` and `[f45] 300 pictures` lines (INVALID without). In live play: `off the pattern 0`; `[present]` held 1/2/3+ about 2 : 1 : 0; pattern slips under 8 % of the 45 pictures (late + held to a later predicted slot); interpolation error: pictures off their show vblank only behind slips (mean under 0.05 refreshes); no FALLBACK line at Vice; at most one fallback per match and never back and forth; `[speed]` 98 % or better; `[lat]` pad->shown p50 within 10 ms of the 30 FPS run (d30). Held scenes at 30 as in d30.
